exposure: Digital vaginal examination (DVE) performed by midwives
Intrapartum ultrasonography (IPU) performed by expert obstetrician
Digital vaginal examination (DVE) performed by expert obstetrician
outcome: Agreement between IPU and DVE measurements
cohort: The study included 196 pregnant women with low-risk pregnancies, singleton vertex presentation, admitted to the delivery ward after 37 weeks of gestation.
finding: IPU can be accurately used by midwives in delivery wards to determine fetal head position and station and cervical dilation with less discomfort for pregnant women compared to DVE.
cross-section timing: Measurements were performed during admission to the delivery ward for labor.
